What We Do

Our Roofing Services

From a slipped slate or a leaking flat roof to a full re-roof, a lead dormer or a new roof window.

Roof Replacements

Old coverings stripped back, then new membrane, battens and tiles or slates, finished at the ridge and verges.

Get a quote

Slate Roofing

Slate roofs laid and repaired, right down to decorative patterns cut into the slate.

Get a quote

Flat Roofing

Torch-on felt flat roofs for extensions, garages and dormers, with roof lights built in where you want them.

Get a quote

Leadwork and Dormers

Lead-clad dormers, flashings, valleys and finials, dressed by hand to keep the weather out.

Get a quote

Roof Windows

Roof windows fitted into slate and tile roofs and flashed in properly so they stay dry.

Get a quote

Roof Repairs

Slipped tiles, leaks, ridges, verges, chimneys and guttering put right before they get worse.

Get a quote

Do It Once, Do It Right

Why Choose J Parrish Roofing Ltd

Every job starts with a proper look at the roof and a clear, free quote, so you know what is being done and why before anything starts. Then it gets done the way it says on the side of the van.

  • Free, Clear Quotes

    We look at the roof properly and price the job before any work starts, with no obligation.

  • Kept in the Loop

    You will know what we found, what we are doing about it and when we will be back.

  • Done Right First Time

    A roof done properly the first time is a roof you do not pay for twice.

  • Slate, Tile, Flat and Lead

    One crew for every part of the roof, from the slates and lead to the flat roof and the roof windows.

  • Local to the North East

    Working on homes across Tyne and Wear and County Durham.

About Us

The Team Behind J Parrish Roofing Ltd

J Parrish Roofing is run by Jay Parrish, with a crew working on homes across Tyne and Wear and County Durham: slate and tile roofs, flat roofs, leadwork, dormers and roof windows.

[PLACEHOLDER how Jay Parrish started in roofing and for how long, in the owner's own words.]

The motto on the van is the one we work to: do it once, do it right. Whether it is a single slipped slate or a full re-roof, it gets done properly the first time.
